units.source_text: 八亲王上佛堂去后，薰君就召唤那个不问自语的老侍女弁君到这室中，

en.t: After the Eighth Prince went to the Buddha hall, Lord Kaoru summoned Ben no Kimi, the old waiting woman who had spoken without being asked, into this room,

units.source_text: 要她把上次未曾说完的许多话继续叙述。

en.t: and had her continue telling the many things she had not finished saying last time.

units.source_text: 月亮即将下山，清光照遍全室，帘内窈窕的人影隐约可见，

en.t: The moon was about to sink behind the hills, its clear light filled the whole room, and the graceful figures behind the blinds could be faintly seen,

units.source_text: 两位女公子便退入内室。

en.t: so the two young ladies withdrew into the inner room.

units.source_text: 她们看见薰君不是世间寻常的好色男子，说起话来斯文一脉，

en.t: Seeing that Lord Kaoru was not the usual amorous man of the world, and that his manner of speaking was consistently refined,

units.source_text: 她们有时便也在室内作一些适当的答话。

en.t: they sometimes made a few suitable replies from within the room.

units.source_text: 薰君心中想起匂皇子迫不及待地想会见这两位女公子，觉得自己毕竟和别人不同。

en.t: Lord Kaoru thought of how impatient Prince Niou was to meet these two young ladies, and felt that he was, after all, different from others.

units.source_text: 他想：“八亲王如此诚恳地自动将女儿许给我，我却并不急于欲得。

en.t: He thought, "The Eighth Prince has so sincerely offered his daughters to me of his own accord, yet I am in no hurry to possess them.

units.source_text: 其实我并不是想疏远这两位小姐而坚决拒绝结婚。

en.t: In truth, it is not that I mean to keep these two ladies at a distance and firmly refuse marriage.

units.source_text: 我和她们如此互相通问，春秋佳日、樱花红叶之时，

en.t: If I continue exchanging messages with them like this, on fine days in spring and autumn, when cherry blossoms or autumn leaves are at their height,

units.source_text: 向她们罄吐哀愁之情与风月之趣，从而赚得她们深切的同感——

en.t: and pour out to them all my sorrowful feelings and my delight in the beauties of nature, thereby winning their deep sympathy,

units.source_text: 像这样的对象，如果我和她们没有宿缘而任她们做了别人的妻子，

en.t: then with companions such as these, if there were no destined bond between us and I let them become other men's wives,
it would, after all, be a great pity."

units.source_text: 他心中已把女公子据为己有了。

en.t: In his heart, he had already claimed the young ladies as his own.
